name -> (font-weight, font-style) "Normal": ("normal", "normal"), "Bold": ("bold", "normal"), "Italic": ("normal", "italic"), "Bold Italic": ("bold", "italic"), } H_ALIGNS: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = { # name -> (flex alignment, text-align) "Center": ("center", "center"), "Left": ("flex-start", "left"), "Right": ("flex-end", "right"), } V_ALIGNS: dict[str, str] = {"Middle": "center", "Top": "flex-start", "Bottom": "flex-end"} FAVICON = ( "" "\">" ) PAGES_BLOCK = re.compile(r"(// PAGES-BEGIN\n)(.*?)(\n\s*// PAGES-END)", re.S) HREF = re.compile(r'href="([^"#?]+\.html)') PLACEHOLDER = "" # rem v_align: str = "Middle" v_indent: float = 0.0 # rem lines: list[LineSpec] = field(default_factory=list) @classmethod def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> PageSpec: try: number = int(data.get("number")) except (TypeError, ValueError): raise ValueError("Page number must be a whole number") from None name = " ".join(str(data.get("name", "")).split()) if not name: raise ValueError("Page name is required") if len(name) > 40 or re.search(r"[<>\"\\]", name): raise ValueError('Page name: 40 characters max, without < > " \\') raw_lines = data.get("lines") or [] if len(raw_lines) > MAX_LINES: raise ValueError(f"A page has at most {MAX_LINES} lines") lines = [LineSpec.from_dict(d, i + 1) for i, d in enumerate(raw_lines)] lines = [ln for ln in lines if ln.text] if not lines: raise ValueError("Enter text on at least one line") return cls( number=number, name=name, h_align=_choice(data, "h_align", H_ALIGNS, "Center", "Horizontal alignment"), h_indent=_number(data, "h_indent", 0, 0, 50, "Horizontal indent"), v_align=_choice(data, "v_align", V_ALIGNS, "Middle", "Vertical alignment"), v_indent=_number(data, "v_indent", 0, 0, 50, "Vertical indent"), lines=lines, ) def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]: return { "number": self.number, "name": self.name, "h_align": self.h_align, "h_indent": self.h_indent, "v_align": self.v_align, "v_indent": self.v_indent, "lines": [ln.__dict__ for ln in self.lines], } # """Local web server for MOTIVATE: serves site/ and the page builder API.

Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The server stops by itself after `idle_minutes`
without any request (open pages ping it every minute).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from app import page_builder

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_BODY = 1_000_000


class MotivateServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    """HTTP server that remembers its site folder and the time of the last request."""

    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, port: int, site_dir: Path, backup_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.site_dir = site_dir
        self.backup_dir = backup_dir
        self.last_request = time.monotonic()
        self.write_lock = threading.Lock()
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", port), partial(Handler, directory=str(site_dir)))

    def serve_until_idle(self, idle_minutes: float) -> None:
        """Serve requests; shut down after idle_minutes with no requests."""
        def watchdog() -> None:
            while True:
                time.sleep(30)
                if time.monotonic() - self.last_request > idle_minutes * 60:
                    log.info("No requests for %s minutes; stopping server", idle_minutes)
                    self.shutdown()
                    return

        threading.Thread(target=watchdog, daemon=True).start()
        log.info("Serving %s at http://127.0.0.1:%s/", self.site_dir, self.server_address[1])
        self.serve_forever()
        self.server_close()


class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Static files from site/ plus /api/ping, /api/preview and /api/create."""

    server: MotivateServer

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:  # noqa: A002 - stdlib signature
        log.debug("%s - %s", self.address_string(), format % args)

    def end_headers(self) -> None:
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        super().end_headers()

    def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _local_request(self) -> bool:
        """Reject requests from other web sites (Host/Origin must be this server)."""
        port = self.server.server_address[1]
        allowed = {f"127.0.0.1:{port}", f"localhost:{port}"}
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        return self.headers.get("Host") in allowed and (
            origin is None or origin.removeprefix("http://") in allowed
        )

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        if self.path.split("?")[0] == "/api/ping":
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "app": "MOTIVATE"})
            return
        super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        route = self.path.split("?")[0]
        if route not in ("/api/preview", "/api/create"):
            self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": "Unknown action"})
            return
        if not self._local_request() or self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0] != "application/json":
            log.warning("Rejected %s from Origin=%s Host=%s", route, self.headers.get("Origin"), self.headers.get("Host"))
            self._send_json(403, {"ok": False, "error": "Request refused"})
            return
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not 0 < length <= MAX_BODY:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": "Empty or too large request"})
            return
        try:
            spec = page_builder.PageSpec.from_dict(json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)))
            with self.server.write_lock:
                if route == "/api/preview":
                    path = page_builder.write_preview(self.server.site_dir, spec)
                else:
                    log.info("User action: create page %s %r", spec.number, spec.name)
                    path = page_builder.insert_page(self.server.site_dir, spec, self.server.backup_dir)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)})
            return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - report to the page, details in the log
            log.exception("Page builder %s failed", route)
            self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": "Unexpected error - see logs\\app.log"})
            return
        self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "file": path.name})


def is_running(port: int) -> bool:
    """True if a MOTIVATE server already answers on this port."""
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/ping", timeout=1) as resp:
            return json.load(resp).get("app") == "MOTIVATE"
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return False

"""Local web server for MOTIVATE: serves site/ and the page builder API.

Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The server stops by itself after `idle_minutes`
without any request (open pages ping it every minute).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from app import page_builder

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_BODY = 1_000_000


class MotivateServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    """HTTP server that remembers its site folder and the time of the last request."""

    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, port: int, site_dir: Path, backup_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.site_dir = site_dir
        self.backup_dir = backup_dir
        self.last_request = time.monotonic()
        self.write_lock = threading.Lock()
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", port), partial(Handler, directory=str(site_dir)))

    def serve_until_idle(self, idle_minutes: float) -> None:
        """Serve requests; shut down after idle_minutes with no requests."""
        def watchdog() -> None:
            while True:
                time.sleep(30)
                if time.monotonic() - self.last_request > idle_minutes * 60:
                    log.info("No requests for %s minutes; stopping server", idle_minutes)
                    self.shutdown()
                    return

        threading.Thread(target=watchdog, daemon=True).start()
        log.info("Serving %s at http://127.0.0.1:%s/", self.site_dir, self.server_address[1])
        self.serve_forever()
        self.server_close()


class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Static files from site/ plus /api/ping, /api/preview and /api/create."""

    server: MotivateServer

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:  # noqa: A002 - stdlib signature
        log.debug("%s - %s", self.address_string(), format % args)

    def end_headers(self) -> None:
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        super().end_headers()

    def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _local_request(self) -> bool:
        """Reject requests from other web sites (Host/Origin must be this server)."""
        port = self.server.server_address[1]
        allowed = {f"127.0.0.1:{port}", f"localhost:{port}"}
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        return self.headers.get("Host") in allowed and (
            origin is None or origin.removeprefix("http://") in allowed
        )

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        if self.path.split("?")[0] == "/api/ping":
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "app": "MOTIVATE"})
            return
        super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        route = self.path.split("?")[0]
        if route not in ("/api/preview", "/api/create"):
            self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": "Unknown action"})
            return
        if not self._local_request() or self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0] != "application/json":
            log.warning("Rejected %s from Origin=%s Host=%s", route, self.headers.get("Origin"), self.headers.get("Host"))
            self._send_json(403, {"ok": False, "error": "Request refused"})
            return
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not 0 < length <= MAX_BODY:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": "Empty or too large request"})
            return
        try:
            spec = page_builder.PageSpec.from_dict(json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)))
            with self.server.write_lock:
                if route == "/api/preview":
                    path = page_builder.write_preview(self.server.site_dir, spec)
                else:
                    log.info("User action: create page %s %r", spec.number, spec.name)
                    path = page_builder.insert_page(self.server.site_dir, spec, self.server.backup_dir)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)})
            return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - report to the page, details in the log
            log.exception("Page builder %s failed", route)
            self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": "Unexpected error - see logs\\app.log"})
            return
        self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "file": path.name})


def is_running(port: int) -> bool:
    """True if a MOTIVATE server already answers on this port."""
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/ping", timeout=1) as resp:
            return json.load(resp).get("app") == "MOTIVATE"
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return False

"""Logic for the MOTIVATE launcher: config, logging, and opening the site.

Runs under pythonw.exe: no console, no print(). Errors are logged and shown
in a native Windows message box (no Tk window is created).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import json
import logging
import sys
import traceback
import webbrowser
from datetime import datetime
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
from pathlib import Path
from types import TracebackType
from typing import Any
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from app import server
from app.server import MotivateServer

APP_NAME = "MOTIVATE"
PROJECT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SITE_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "site"
LOG_FILE = PROJECT_DIR / "logs" / "app.log"
CONFIG_FILE = PROJECT_DIR / "config.json"
ERROR_LOG = PROJECT_DIR / "error_log.txt"
BACKUP_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "assets" / "archives" / "saved"
EDT = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")

DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {
    "log_level": "INFO",
    "start_page": "index.html",
    "port": 8765,
    "idle_minutes": 120,
}

# MOTIVATE Webpage

## Purpose
Full-screen trading motivation pages (rules, principles, reminders) kept in view during the
trading session. Static HTML/CSS/JS, opened in the default browser by a small pythonw launcher.

## Folder Structure
```
motivate_webpage\
  MOTIVATE.html            original single-file version (kept as-is, reference only)
  MOTIVATE.lnk             shortcut -> .venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe main.py
  main.py                  entry point: logging, config, opens site\<start_page>
  app\launcher.py          config, EDT logging, error dialogs, open-in-browser logic
  site\                    THE WEBPAGE (multi-page version)
    index.html             home: title + one tile per page (built from nav.js PAGES)
    01_key_points.html ... 12_principles.html   one file per original page
    13_patience.html       developed from page 2 line "BE PATIENT - FOCUSED AND DISCIPLINED"
    css\motivate.css       shared look (fonts, colors, menu, page indicator, arrows)
    js\nav.js              shared navigation; PAGES list = single source of truth
  assets\                  MOTIVATE.ico, MOTIVATE_info_page.docx (help), archives\ (old versions)
  docs\                    MOTIVATE NOTES.md, SESSION_HISTORY.md, sessions\ (raw transcripts)
  logs\app.log             rotating log (1 MB x 5), EDT timestamps
  tests\test_site.py       pytest: page list, links, balanced markup, launcher logic
  config.json              log_level, start_page
```

## Venv & Commands
- Python: C:\Users\Jerome\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python314\python.exe
- Venv: `.venv\` (create: `python -m venv .venv`, then `.venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt`)
- Launch: double-click `MOTIVATE.lnk`, or `.venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe main.py`
- View without launcher: open `site\index.html` in a browser
- Test: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest` (ask JR before running)

## Dependencies (requirements.txt, pinned)
- tzdata (America/New_York on Windows); pytest (tests); Pillow (icon generation)

## Config (config.json)
- `log_level`: INFO | DEBUG
- `start_page`: file in site\ opened by the launcher (default index.html; invalid -> index.html)

## Conventions
- Each page: `<body data-page="N">`, links `css/motivate.css` and `js/nav.js`; page-specific
  `.style-one`..`.style-seven` rules in its own `<style>` (scoped `.page .style-x`).
- Adding a page: create `NN_name.html`, then add one entry to `PAGES` in `site\js\nav.js`
  (menu, arrows, index tiles, and page number update automatically); update tests count.
- Look & feel: white background, Arial Black / Arial, colors #083a5e navy, #0070c0 blue,
  #ff0000 red, #00b050 green; rem-based fluid font sizes.
- Navigation: hamburger menu (current page green), ◄ ► wrap around, Left/Right arrow keys, Esc closes menu.
- Old links `MOTIVATE.html#N` map to `site\index.html#N`, which redirects to page N.
- American spelling; all times EDT. Launcher runs under pythonw.exe (no console, no print()).
- Log every session in `docs\SESSION_HISTORY.md` (date, request, decisions, files changed).

"""Build MOTIVATE_info_page.docx in JR's default docx format."""
import sys
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor

SECTIONS = [
    ("MOTIVATE - Info Page", None),
    ("Purpose", [
        "MOTIVATE is a set of full-screen trading motivation pages (rules, principles, and reminders) "
        "to keep in view during the trading session.",
        "Each page is its own HTML file in the site folder; index.html is the home page with a tile for every page.",
    ]),
    ("How to Use", [
        "Double-click the MOTIVATE shortcut. The home page opens in your default web browser.",
        "Click a tile to open that page.",
        "Hamburger menu (top left): opens the page list; the current page is shown in green.",
        "Arrows next to the menu: previous / next page (wraps around). The Left and Right arrow keys do the same.",
        "The small number under the menu is the current page number.",
        "Esc or a click outside the menu closes it.",
        "On page 2 (Marathon), click BE PATIENT - FOCUSED AND DISCIPLINED to open page 13 (Patience).",
    ]),
    ("Options", [
        "config.json - start_page: the page the shortcut opens (default index.html, e.g. 01_key_points.html).",
        r"config.json - log_level: INFO (default) or DEBUG. The log is in logs\app.log (EDT times).",
        "To add a page: copy an existing page file, change data-page in its <body> tag, "
        r"and add one line to the PAGES list in site\js\nav.js.",
    ]),
    ("Pages", [
        "0 Home, 1 Key Points, 2 Marathon, 3 Hope, 4 Stops, 5 Thinking, 6 Page 6, 7 Page 7, 8 Page 8, "
        "9 Why, 10 Rules, 11 Truths, 12 Principles, 13 Patience.",
    ]),
]

doc = Document()
for s in doc.sections:
    s.top_margin = s.bottom_margin = s.left_margin = s.right_margin = Inches(0.75)
normal = doc.styles["Normal"]
normal.font.name = "Arial"
normal.font.size = Pt(12)
normal.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
normal.element.rPr.rFonts.set("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}eastAsia", "Arial")
pf = normal.paragraph_format
pf.line_spacing = 1.15
pf.space_before = Pt(0)
pf.space_after = Pt(0)
pf.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

def para(text="", bold=False, size=12, bullet=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if bullet else None)
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15
    if text:
        r = p.add_run(text)
        r.bold = bold
        r.font.name = "Arial"
        r.font.size = Pt(size)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)

for i, (title, lines) in enumerate(SECTIONS):
    if i:
        para()  # one extra space between paragraphs
    para(title, bold=True, size=14)
    for ln in lines or []:
        para(ln, bullet=True)
doc.save(sys.argv[1])

The home page boxes are redone and the page builder is built. Nothing has been run in a browser yet, and the tests are written but not run; both need your OK under your guide. I did a syntax check on the Python files.

**Home page**
- The boxes now read "1 - KEY POINTS" in black Arial, with rounded corners, shorter and wider than before, 4 per row (2 per row on a narrow screen).
- I created real placeholder pages 14, 15 and 16, so the home page shows "14 - PAGE 14" through "16 - PAGE 16". Your message was cut off after "14 - PAGE", so I guessed that wording; tell me if you meant something else.

**Page builder**
- **How you open it:** a small black circle with a white "A" in the bottom-right corner of every page opens [builder.html](site/builder.html).
- **Page number:** this is where the new page goes. The default is the page after the one you came from. A hint shows what will happen, for example "Inserted before 5 - THINKING; pages 5-16 become 6-17", and you get a confirmation before anything is renumbered. Renumbering updates the file names, page numbers, menu, home boxes, JR tab titles and links between pages.
- **Page name:** shown in the menu and on the home page box.
- **Alignment:** horizontal Center / Left / Right, and vertical Middle / Top / Bottom, each with an indent (default 0). The indent only applies to Left/Right and Top/Bottom, since a centered page has no edge to indent from. You wrote "center, right align, right align", so I took the second one to mean Left.
- **Lines 1 to 20:** each line has its own text, font, size, font type (Normal, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic), color and spacing after. The color picker suggests your palette colors, and empty lines are skipped. Sizes, indents and spacing are in rem, the same unit your pages already use; 1 rem is about the height of normal text.
- **Buttons:**
  - **PREVIEW** opens the page in its own tab without saving.
  - **CREATE** backs up the whole site to a zip in `assets\archives\saved\`, saves the page and opens it.
  - **RESET** clears the form.
  - **EXIT** goes back.
- **Draft:** the form remembers what you typed until CREATE or RESET.

**What changed in how MOTIVATE starts**
- **Why:** a page opened straight from disk can't write files, so the MOTIVATE shortcut now also starts a small local server. Only this computer can reach it, and the builder does its file work through it.
- **If opened directly from disk:** if you open `site\index.html` without the shortcut, the builder shows a red note and PREVIEW and CREATE are disabled.
- **Auto-stop:** the server stops after 120 minutes with no MOTIVATE page open (set in [config.json](config.json)). If your PC sleeps longer than that, double-click the shortcut again.

I made pages 14 to 16 with the builder's own code, so that also exercised it on your real site: the backup zip was written and the menu list was updated correctly. The builder logic is in [page_builder.py](app/page_builder.py) and the server is in [server.py](app/server.py). The CLAUDE.md, NOTES, help docx, session history, project list entry and memory notes are all updated.

**Decisions for you**

"""Local web server for MOTIVATE: serves site/ and the page builder API.

Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The server stops by itself after `idle_minutes`
without any request (open pages ping it every minute).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from app import page_builder

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_BODY = 1_000_000


class MotivateServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    """HTTP server that remembers its site folder and the time of the last request."""

    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, port: int, site_dir: Path, backup_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.site_dir = site_dir
        self.backup_dir = backup_dir
        self.last_request = time.monotonic()
        self.write_lock = threading.Lock()
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", port), partial(Handler, directory=str(site_dir)))

    def serve_until_idle(self, idle_minutes: float) -> None:
        """Serve requests; shut down after idle_minutes with no requests."""
        def watchdog() -> None:
            while True:
                time.sleep(30)
                if time.monotonic() - self.last_request > idle_minutes * 60:
                    log.info("No requests for %s minutes; stopping server", idle_minutes)
                    self.shutdown()
                    return

        threading.Thread(target=watchdog, daemon=True).start()
        log.info("Serving %s at http://127.0.0.1:%s/", self.site_dir, self.server_address[1])
        self.serve_forever()
        self.server_close()


class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Static files from site/ plus /api/ping, /api/preview and /api/create."""

    server: MotivateServer

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:  # noqa: A002 - stdlib signature
        log.debug("%s - %s", self.address_string(), format % args)

    def end_headers(self) -> None:
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        super().end_headers()

    def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _local_request(self) -> bool:
        """Reject requests from other web sites (Host/Origin must be this server)."""
        port = self.server.server_address[1]
        allowed = {f"127.0.0.1:{port}", f"localhost:{port}"}
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        return self.headers.get("Host") in allowed and (
            origin is None or origin.removeprefix("http://") in allowed
        )

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        if self.path.split("?")[0] == "/api/ping":
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "app": "MOTIVATE"})
            return
        super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        route = self.path.split("?")[0]
        if route not in ("/api/preview", "/api/create"):
            self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": "Unknown action"})
            return
        if not self._local_request() or self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0] != "application/json":
            log.warning("Rejected %s from Origin=%s Host=%s", route, self.headers.get("Origin"), self.headers.get("Host"))
            self._send_json(403, {"ok": False, "error": "Request refused"})
            return
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not 0 < length <= MAX_BODY:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": "Empty or too large request"})
            return
        try:
            spec = page_builder.PageSpec.from_dict(json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)))
            with self.server.write_lock:
                if route == "/api/preview":
                    path = page_builder.write_preview(self.server.site_dir, spec)
                else:
                    log.info("User action: create page %s %r", spec.number, spec.name)
                    path = page_builder.insert_page(self.server.site_dir, spec, self.server.backup_dir)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)})
            return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - report to the page, details in the log
            log.exception("Page builder %s failed", route)
            self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": "Unexpected error - see logs\\app.log"})
            return
        self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "file": path.name})


def is_running(port: int) -> bool:
    """True if a MOTIVATE server already answers on this port."""
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/ping", timeout=1) as resp:
            return json.load(resp).get("app") == "MOTIVATE"
    except (OSError, ValueError):

"""Local web server for MOTIVATE: serves site/ and the page builder API.

Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The server stops by itself after `idle_minutes`
without any request (open pages ping it every minute).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from app import page_builder

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_BODY = 1_000_000


class MotivateServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    """HTTP server that remembers its site folder and the time of the last request."""

    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, port: int, site_dir: Path, backup_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.site_dir = site_dir
        self.backup_dir = backup_dir
        self.last_request = time.monotonic()
        self.write_lock = threading.Lock()
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", port), partial(Handler, directory=str(site_dir)))

    def serve_until_idle(self, idle_minutes: float) -> None:
        """Serve requests; shut down after idle_minutes with no requests."""
        def watchdog() -> None:
            while True:
                time.sleep(30)
                if time.monotonic() - self.last_request > idle_minutes * 60:
                    log.info("No requests for %s minutes; stopping server", idle_minutes)
                    self.shutdown()
                    return

        threading.Thread(target=watchdog, daemon=True).start()
        log.info("Serving %s at http://127.0.0.1:%s/", self.site_dir, self.server_address[1])
        self.serve_forever()
        self.server_close()


class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Static files from site/ plus /api/ping, /api/preview and /api/create."""

    server: MotivateServer

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:  # noqa: A002 - stdlib signature
        log.debug("%s - %s", self.address_string(), format % args)

    def end_headers(self) -> None:
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        super().end_headers()

    def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _local_request(self) -> bool:
        """Reject requests from other web sites (Host/Origin must be this server)."""
        port = self.server.server_address[1]
        allowed = {f"127.0.0.1:{port}", f"localhost:{port}"}
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        return self.headers.get("Host") in allowed and (
            origin is None or origin.removeprefix("http://") in allowed
        )

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        url = urlsplit(self.path)
        if url.path == "/api/ping":
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "app": "MOTIVATE"})
        elif url.path == "/api/page":
            try:
                number = int(parse_qs(url.query).get("n", [""])[0])
                spec = page_builder.load_page(self.server.site_dir, number)
            except ValueError as exc:
                self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": str(exc) or "Invalid page number"})
                return
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - report to the page, details in the log
                log.exception("Loading page %s failed", self.path)
                self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": "Unexpected error - see logs\\app.log"})
                return
            log.info("User action: load page %s for editing", number)
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "spec": spec.to_dict()})
        else:
            super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib name
        self.server.last_request = time.monotonic()
        route = self.path.split("?")[0]
        if route not in ("/api/preview", "/api/create", "/api/update"):
            self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": "Unknown action"})
            return
        if not self._local_request() or self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0] != "application/json":
            log.warning("Rejected %s from Origin=%s Host=%s", route, self.headers.get("Origin"), self.headers.get("Host"))
            self._send_json(403, {"ok": False, "error": "Request refused"})
            return
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not 0 < length <= MAX_BODY:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": "Empty or too large request"})
            return
        try:
            spec = page_builder.PageSpec.from_dict(json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)))
            with self.server.write_lock:
                if route == "/api/preview":
                    path = page_builder.write_preview(self.server.site_dir, spec)
                else:
                    log.info("User action: create page %s %r", spec.number, spec.name)
                    path = page_builder.insert_page(self.server.site_dir, spec, self.server.backup_dir)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)})
            return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - report to the page, details in the log
            log.exception("Page builder %s failed", route)
            self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": "Unexpected error - see logs\\app.log"})
            return
        self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "file": path.name})


def is_running(port: int) -> bool:
    """True if a MOTIVATE server already answers on this port."""
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api/ping", timeout=1) as resp:
            return json.load(resp).get("app") == "MOTIVATE"
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return False

closed in order.""" def __init__(self) -> None: super().__init__() self.stack: list[str] = [] self.refs: list[str] = [] self.errors: list[str] = [] self.body_page: str | None = None def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None: a = dict(attrs) if tag == "body": self.body_page = a.get("data-page") for key in ("href", "src"): if a.get(key) and not """Build MOTIVATE_info_page.docx in JR's default docx format."""
import sys
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor

SECTIONS = [
    ("MOTIVATE - Info Page", None),
    ("Purpose", [
        "MOTIVATE is a set of full-screen trading motivation pages (rules, principles, and reminders) "
        "to keep in view during the trading session.",
        "Each page is its own HTML file in the site folder; index.html is the home page with a box for every page.",
        "The PAGE BUILDER creates new pages from a form, without editing any HTML.",
    ]),
    ("How to Use", [
        "Double-click the MOTIVATE shortcut. The home page opens in your default web browser.",
        "Click a box (e.g. 1 - KEY POINTS) to open that page.",
        "Hamburger menu (top left): opens the page list; the current page is shown in green.",
        "Arrows next to the menu: previous / next page (wraps around). The Left and Right arrow keys do the same.",
        "The small number under the menu is the current page number.",
        "Esc or a click outside the menu closes it.",
        "On page 2 (Marathon), click BE PATIENT - FOCUSED AND DISCIPLINED to open page 13 (Patience).",
    ]),
    ("Page Builder", [
        "Click the small black A circle in the bottom-right corner of any page.",
        "Page Number: where the new page goes. The pages from that number on move up by one "
        "(files, menu, home boxes, page numbers, and links are all updated). The default is the page after the one you came from.",
        "Page Name: shown in the menu and on the home page box.",
        "Horizontal Align: Center, Left, or Right, with an indent for Left/Right. "
        "Vertical Align: Middle, Top, or Bottom, with an indent for Top/Bottom.",
        "Lines 1 to 20: text, font, font size, font type (Normal, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic), font color, and spacing after. "
        "Empty lines are skipped. Sizes, indents, and spacing are in rem (1 rem is about the height of normal text).",
        "PREVIEW opens the page in its own tab without saving. CREATE saves it and opens it. "
        "RESET clears the form. EXIT goes back. The form is remembered until CREATE or RESET.",
        r"Before every CREATE, the whole site is backed up to assets\archives\saved\site_backup_<date_time>.zip.",
        "The builder works only when MOTIVATE is opened with its shortcut (it needs the local MOTIVATE server).",
    ]),
    ("Options", [
        "config.json - start_page: the page the shortcut opens (default index.html, e.g. 01_key_points.html).",
        r"config.json - log_level: INFO (default) or DEBUG. The log is in logs\app.log (EDT times).",
        "config.json - port: local server port (default 8765). idle_minutes: the server stops after this long "
        "with no page open (default 120); double-click the shortcut again to restart it.",
    ]),
    ("Pages", [
        "0 Home, 1 Key Points, 2 Marathon, 3 Hope, 4 Stops, 5 Thinking, 6 Page 6, 7 Page 7, 8 Page 8, "
        "9 Why, 10 Rules, 11 Truths, 12 Principles, 13 Patience, 14 to 16 placeholders (PAGE 14, PAGE 15, PAGE 16).",
    ]),
]

doc = Document()
for s in doc.sections:
    s.top_margin = s.bottom_margin = s.left_margin = s.right_margin = Inches(0.75)
normal = doc.styles["Normal"]
normal.font.name = "Arial"
normal.font.size = Pt(12)
normal.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
normal.element.rPr.rFonts.set("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}eastAsia", "Arial")
pf = normal.paragraph_format
pf.line_spacing = 1.15
pf.space_before = Pt(0)
pf.space_after = Pt(0)
pf.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

def para(text="", bold=False, size=12, bullet=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if bullet else None)
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15
    if text:
        r = p.add_run(text)
        r.bold = bold
        r.font.name = "Arial"
        r.font.size = Pt(size)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)

for i, (title, lines) in enumerate(SECTIONS):
    if i:
        para()  # one extra space between paragraphs
    para(title, bold=True, size=14)
    for ln in lines or []:
        para(ln, bullet=True)
doc.save(sys.argv[1])

# MOTIVATE Webpage

## Purpose
Full-screen trading motivation pages (rules, principles, reminders) kept in view during the
trading session. Static HTML/CSS/JS served by a small local pythonw server (127.0.0.1 only),
which also powers the in-page PAGE BUILDER (black "A" circle, bottom right of every page).

## Folder Structure
```
motivate_webpage\
  MOTIVATE.html            original single-file version (kept as-is, reference only)
  MOTIVATE.lnk             shortcut -> .venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe main.py
  main.py                  entry point: logging, config, starts server, opens site\<start_page>
  app\launcher.py          config, EDT logging, error dialogs, open-in-browser / server start
  app\server.py            local HTTP server: serves site\, /api/ping, /api/preview, /api/create
  app\page_builder.py      builder logic: validate spec, render page, insert + renumber, backup
  site\                    THE WEBPAGE (multi-page version)
    index.html             home: title + 4-per-row rounded boxes "N - NAME" (built from nav.js PAGES)
    builder.html           PAGE BUILDER form (not in PAGES); _preview.html = temporary preview
    01_key_points.html ... 12_principles.html   one file per original page
    13_patience.html       developed from page 2 line "BE PATIENT - FOCUSED AND DISCIPLINED"
    14_page_14 .. 16_page_16.html   placeholders (marked <!-- placeholder -->)
    css\motivate.css       shared look (fonts, colors, menu, page indicator, arrows, A button)
    js\nav.js              shared navigation; PAGES list (PAGES-BEGIN/END, one JSON object per
                           line) = single source of truth, rewritten by the page builder
  assets\                  MOTIVATE.ico, MOTIVATE_info_page.docx (help), archives\ (old versions)
  assets\archives\saved\   original MOTIVATE.html backup + site_backup_*.zip (before every CREATE)
  docs\                    MOTIVATE NOTES.md, SESSION_HISTORY.md, sessions\ (raw transcripts)
  logs\app.log             rotating log (1 MB x 5), EDT timestamps
  tests\test_site.py       pytest: page list, links, balanced markup, launcher logic
  config.json              log_level, start_page
```

## Venv & Commands
- Python: C:\Users\Jerome\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python314\python.exe
- Venv: `.venv\` (create: `python -m venv .venv`, then `.venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt`)
- Launch: double-click `MOTIVATE.lnk`, or `.venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe main.py`
  (starts the server on 127.0.0.1:<port>, reuses it if already running; stops after idle_minutes)
- View without launcher: open `site\index.html` in a browser (builder is then read-only)
- Test: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest` (ask JR before running)

## Dependencies (requirements.txt, pinned)
- tzdata (America/New_York on Windows); pytest (tests); Pillow (icon generation)

## Config (config.json)
- `log_level`: INFO | DEBUG
- `start_page`: file in site\ opened by the launcher (default index.html; invalid -> index.html)
- `port`: local server port (default 8765)
- `idle_minutes`: server stops after this long with no requests (default 120; open pages ping every minute)

## Conventions
- Each page: `<body data-page="N">`, links `css/motivate.css` and `js/nav.js`; page-specific
  `.style-one`..`.style-seven` rules in its own `<style>` (scoped `.page .style-x`).
- Adding a page: use the PAGE BUILDER (renumbers files, data-page, JRn titles, links between pages,
  and PAGES). Manual: create `NN_name.html` and add one line to `PAGES` in `site\js\nav.js`.
- Builder units are rem; fonts, font types, and alignments are whitelisted in app\page_builder.py.
- Builder POSTs are accepted only with Host/Origin = 127.0.0.1/localhost:<port> and a JSON body.
- Look & feel: white background, Arial Black / Arial, colors #083a5e navy, #0070c0 blue,
  #ff0000 red, #00b050 green; rem-based fluid font sizes.
- Navigation: hamburger menu (current page green), ◄ ► wrap around, Left/Right arrow keys, Esc closes menu.
- Old links `MOTIVATE.html#N` map to `site\index.html#N`, which redirects to page N.
- American spelling; all times EDT. Launcher runs under pythonw.exe (no console, no print()).
- Log every session in `docs\SESSION_HISTORY.md` (date, request, decisions, files changed).

"""Checks on the multi-page site and the launcher logic (no browser is opened).""" import json from html.parser import HTMLParser from pathlib import Path import pytest from app import launcher, page_builder SITE = launcher.SITE_DIR NAV_PAGES = [(p["id"], p["file"]) for p in page_builder.read_pages(SITE)] EXTRA_FILES = {"builder.html"} # in site/ but not in the page list HTML_FILES = sorted(p for p in SITE.glob("*.html") if not p.name.startswith("_")) VOID = {"meta", "link", "br", "img", "input", "hr"} class TagBalance(HTMLParser): """Collect hrefs/srcs and verify every non-void tag is closed in order.""" def __init__(self) -> None: super().__init__() self.stack: list[str] = [] self.refs: list[str] = [] self.errors: list[str] = [] self.body_page: str | None = None def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None: a = dict(attrs) if tag == "body": self.body_page = a.get("data-page") for key in ("href", "src"): if a.get(key) and not a[key].startswith(("data:", "#", "http")): self.refs.append(a[key]) if tag not in VOID: self.stack.append(tag) def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None: if not self.stack or self.stack[-1] != tag: self.errors.append(f"unexpected (open: {self.stack[-3:]})") else: self.stack.pop() def parse(path: Path) -> TagBalance: parser = TagBalance() parser.feed(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) return parser def test_page_list_is_numbered_in_order() -> None: assert [i for i, _ in NAV_PAGES] == [str(n) for n in range(len(NAV_PAGES))] for _, file in NAV_PAGES: assert (SITE / file).exists(), file def test_every_html_file_is_in_nav() -> None: assert {p.name for p in HTML_FILES} == {file for _, file in NAV_PAGES} | EXTRA_FILES @pytest.mark.parametrize("path", HTML_FILES, ids=lambda p: p.name) def ## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>

<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

**Do not spawn agents unless the user asks.** Each spawn starts cold and re-derives context you already have — it's the expensive path on this plan. A task with "multiple angles," "thorough," or several parts is not a request to spawn; handle it inline with your own tools. Only use this tool when the user explicitly says to use a subagent, or names one of the available agent types.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

A fork runs in the background and keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate. Subagents run in the background; you'll be notified when one completes. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.
